method: printed contents pp. iii-iv (pdf 3-4); offset printed+12 throughout; every Part page and chapter-number heading located in the text cache. Chapters 1-3 precede Part I and are given at level 0. Where a chapter is preceded by a 1-2 page 'About Chapter N' prologue (prerequisites/orientation for that chapter: chs 1,3,4,5,6,9,10,11,12,13,14,29,31,45,50), the chapter entry starts at the About page so the prologue travels with its chapter (actual heading page in 'note'); toc_check warnings on those entries are expected. 'About Part IV' (pdf 294-295) is left inside the Part IV opening pages. No chapter exceeds 35 pdf pages, so sections are omitted. Appendices A-C sit in Part VII. Complete 2003 CUP on-screen edition (version 7.2, 640 pp.).
